cases.html: verna | 1 — Save bug fix notes before they get lost Hey, Here's the rundown of what we changed this week. Each of these is a self-contained fix, but a few of them touch the same files so please read the whole thing before you start cherry-picking commits into the release branch or you will end up with conflicts that are annoying to untangle later on. - Fixed the mark-as-read dwell timer firing twice on fast scroll. - Reworked the attachment icon lookup so it falls back to a generic glyph. - The notification snippet no longer leaks raw click-tracking redirect URLs. - Reader now remembers the per-email "load images directly" consent. Let me know if any of this is unclear and I'll write it up in more detail. Thanks, Muneeb

cases.html:
Dear readers,


We hope this finds you in good health and spirits.

This Muharram marks the beginning of the sixth year of our book club. To all our members—new and seasoned—thank you for being a part of this beautiful journey. 


Our Muharram selection features two important works that explore the promises and challenges of artificial intelligence:

1. The AI Mirror: How to Reclaim Our Humanity in an Age of Machine Thinking by Shannon Vallor

2. Magnifica Humanitas: On Safeguarding the Human Person in the Time of Artificial Intelligence (Encyclical Letter of Pope Leo XIV) 


The reading guide and links to read and purchase the texts can be found on your dashboard here. 


If you need any assistance, please reply to this email, and we will be happy to support you.

With best wishes for the new year ahead,

Sara Kuratnik
Book Club Program Manager
